open_visual_findings: The two-plane foliage topology remains visible at guide-eye distance and lacks connected branch and crown volume.
Broad water is still dark and nearly planar, with insufficient refractive variation, overturning volume, entrained air, and rapid-scale foam structure.
Terrain macro detail, shoreline transitions, boulder integration, characters, PPE, raft, and animation remain visibly synthetic.
